name: Angry Wives
overview: Scripture highlights the serious challenge of anger and contention within the heart of a wife, describing a brawling or contentious woman as one whose presence brings strife and unrest to the home. Proverbs repeatedly emphasizes that it is better to live in isolation or in a humble place than to dwell with an angry or quarrelsome wife, underscoring the destructive impact of such behavior on family peace. These verses call believers to value gentleness and self-control, recognizing that blessings rest upon the just, while violence and contentiousness bring turmoil.
